name: models-query-200-free-tier-only
notes: GET /v1/models/query?free-tier-only=true with no price book and no free-category provider returns an empty list (200): a model with no known price is never free, and unknown is not $0. The test asserts the list is empty, and a second test with a $0 pair price in the book asserts the free model is then listed. No upstream is called: the handler reads the local catalog, so recorded_response is nominal only.
